title: Advanced Forest Fire Spread with Wind & Scoring
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that simulates an advanced forest fire spreading across a grid-based terrain with wind influence and a scoring system.

## Scene Setup
- Create a 20x20 grid of trees on a flat green ground plane. Each tree is a simple mesh: a brown cylinder trunk (radius 0.15, height 0.6) topped with a green cone canopy (radius 0.4, height 0.8).
- Position the camera at (0, 25, 25) looking at the grid center. Use OrbitControls for camera manipulation.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light from (10, 20, 10) with intensity 0.8.
- The grid cells are spaced 1.5 units apart, centered at origin. Each cell has a state: 'healthy' (green canopy), 'burning' (orange/red canopy with slight scale pulsing animation), 'burned' (dark gray/black canopy, scaled down to 60%), or 'firebreak' (no tree, just bare ground marker).

## Wind System
- Maintain a wind direction vector with angle in degrees (0=North/+Z, 90=East/+X, 180=South/-Z, 270=West/-X) and wind speed (0-3 scale: 0=calm, 1=light, 2=moderate, 3=strong).
- Default wind: direction=90 (East), speed=1.
- Wind affects fire spread probability: base spread chance is 40% per tick to adjacent cardinal cells. Wind increases probability in the downwind direction by +20% per wind speed level, and decreases probability in the upwind direction by -15% per wind speed level. Diagonal spread has half the base probability. Clamp all probabilities to [0, 1].
- Display a wind arrow indicator in the HUD (a styled div arrow or unicode arrow ➤ rotated to match wind direction).

## Fire Simulation
- The simulation runs in discrete ticks. Each tick is 500ms when running.
- A burning tree burns for 3 ticks before becoming 'burned'.
- Each tick, each burning tree attempts to spread fire to adjacent healthy trees based on wind-modified probabilities.
- Use a seeded pseudo-random number generator (seed=42) so spread is deterministic. Implement a simple LCG: next = (a * current + c) % m with a=1664525, c=1013904223, m=2^32. Normalize to [0,1] by dividing by m.

## User Interactions
- Click on a healthy tree (raycasting) to ignite it (set to 'burning'). Only works when simulation is paused or running.
- Press 'F' key to toggle firebreak mode. In firebreak mode, clicking a healthy tree removes it and marks the cell as 'firebreak' (firebreaks block fire spread). Firebreak placements cost 10 points each.
- Press 'Space' to toggle simulation play/pause.
- Press 'R' to fully reset the simulation to initial state (all healthy, score reset, tick reset).
- Press 'W' to cycle wind direction: 0 → 90 → 180 → 270 → 0. Only works when paused.
- Press 'S' to cycle wind speed: 0 → 1 → 2 → 3 → 0. Only works when paused.

## Scoring System
- Start with 1000 points.
- Each tree that becomes 'burned' deducts 15 points.
- Each firebreak placed deducts 10 points.
- Bonus: if simulation ends (no burning trees remain and at least one tree was burned) with >=50% healthy trees, add 200 bonus points.
- Score cannot go below 0.

## HUD / UI
- Top-left panel (semi-transparent dark background, white text) showing:
  - 'Tick: {N}' (current simulation tick)
  - 'Score: {N}'
  - 'Wind: {direction}° Speed: {speed}'
  - 'Status: Paused|Running|Ended'
  - 'Mode: Normal|Firebreak'
  - 'Healthy: {N} | Burning: {N} | Burned: {N} | Firebreaks: {N}'
- A small instruction text at bottom: 'Click=Ignite | Space=Play/Pause | F=Firebreak | W=Wind Dir | S=Wind Speed | R=Reset'

## State Management (CRITICAL)
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame/tick:
  - simulationRunning: boolean
  - simulationEnded: boolean
  - currentTick: number (starts at 0)
  - score: number (starts at 1000)
  - windDirection: number (degrees, one of 0/90/180/270)
  - windSpeed: number (0-3)
  - firebreakMode: boolean
  - healthyCount: number
  - burningCount: number
  - burnedCount: number
  - firebreakCount: number
  - totalTrees: 400 (constant, 20x20)
  - gridState: a flat array of 400 strings ('healthy','burning','burned','firebreak')
  - lastIgnitedCell: {row, col} or null
  - rngState: current LCG state number
  - bonusAwarded: boolean
  - spreadProbabilities: {downwind: number, upwind: number, crosswind: number, diagonal: number} — current computed probabilities based on wind
physics_constraints: Fire spread uses deterministic seeded LCG PRNG (seed=42). Wind modifies spread probability: base 40% ± wind speed * modifier per direction. Burning duration is exactly 3 ticks. Score is conserved: starts at 1000, deductions are 15/burned tree and 10/firebreak. All probabilities clamped to [0,1]. Grid is exactly 20x20=400 cells.
